@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '9280'
+title: 'Gemma3Text: give the checkpoint feeds its own prefill step and window cap'
+---
+## Why
+Found while doing ^237qeb2. `LanguageModel.defaultPrefillStepSize` now carries a model's own prefill step into `PromptCacheCheckpoint.prefill`, the feed `ChatSession` and the FoundationModels executor run up to each message boundary. `Gemma3TextModel.prepare` (Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/Gemma3Text.swift) prefills at its own `defaultPrefillChunkSize` (128) and caps the step at `config.slidingWindow`, but it does not override `defaultPrefillStepSize`, so its checkpoint feeds (it has rotating caches, so checkpoints apply) still run at the generic 512 with no window cap.
+
+## What
+- Decide whether Gemma3Text should give `defaultPrefillStepSize` (128) and whether the checkpoint feed needs a maximum step (the sliding window) the way `prepare` caps it — for example a second `LanguageModel` property for the maximum step.
+- Measure before and after on a Gemma 3 ChatSession prompt.
+
+## Acceptance
+- [ ] A unit test shows the Gemma3Text checkpoint feed step that the decision picks.
+- [ ] All five bundles green. #qwen-perf
\ No newline at end of file

+  text: |-
+    ## Step: implement (2026-11-17)
+
+    Decision: Gemma3Text gives `defaultPrefillStepSize = 128` (the tuned step its prepare already used) and a new `LanguageModel.maximumPrefillStepSize: Int?` (default nil) returns `config.slidingWindow`. Every feed caps at it: `PromptCacheCheckpoint.prefill` passes `maximumStepSize: model.maximumPrefillStepSize`, `Gemma3TextModel.prepare` reads both properties instead of a private constant, the default `LLMModel.prepare` (`prepareInChunks`, new `maximumStepSize: Int? = nil` parameter) honors the cap, and `ForwardingLanguageModel` forwards it.
+
+    Effect: a Gemma 3 checkpoint feed (ChatSession / FoundationModels message boundaries) now reads in the same 128 step as the prepare instead of the generic 512, and a caller step wider than the window is capped at the window in both paths.
+
+    TDD: `Gemma3TextPrefillStepTests` (9 XCTest cases) failed to compile first (no `maximumPrefillStepSize`), now green. It covers the step, the cap, the forwarding model, feeds at 128, feeds capped at a narrow window (default and caller step), and a float32 check that a capped feed + one-token forward gives the same logits (1e-4) and greedy token as the whole prompt in one forward. `PrefillParametersTests` gains "a model without a cap of its own caps no prefill step" and "the default prepare caps the step of the caller at the cap of the model".
+
+    Real-model check: no Gemma 3 checkpoint in the local HF cache (only embeddinggemma-300m CoreML), so the before/after greedy comparison on a real checkpoint and the ChatSession timing were not run; the reference-logits unit test carries the greedy evidence.
